baseline_models.focus_anchor: The covering verb, punishment noun, and paired directions above and beneath the feet.
baseline_models.mechanism: Punishment becomes a complete bodily environment: a general covering closes the upper direction while the lower direction reaches the body's point of support, leaving no neutral exterior.

activation_trace.role: A calamity that covers generally supplies the enveloping shell of the model.
Literal upper direction supplies the enclosure's top boundary.
Literal lower direction supplies the enclosure's bottom boundary.
The bodily foot makes the lower boundary immediate at the point of stance.

changed_reading.before: The punishment comes upon them from several directions.
changed_reading.after: The punishment is a total environment that covers the body and seals both the space over it and the ground of its stance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to taste is directly governed by what they had been doing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken command converts past intentional action into present embodied knowledge: the deed is not merely cited as evidence but returned as the experience itself.

activation_trace.role: Painful punishment supplies the adverse substance of the experience.
An articulated utterance supplies the performative command that initiates the experience.
Experiential testing supplies the conversion from judicial information to bodily knowledge.
Past occurrence supplies the sustained history now made present.
Intentional action supplies the material that returns as experienced consequence.

changed_reading.before: They are punished because of their deeds.
changed_reading.after: Their intentional deeds become the very experience they must taste, so judgment is made bodily known rather than only announced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence moves from a verbal claim through an assay of persons to truth enacted; the focus closes that sequence by moving from final speech to the tasting of prior action.

activation_trace.role: The final articulated command closes the earlier economy of claims.
Experiential testing turns the assay's result into direct knowledge.
Intentional action supplies the tested output rather than a bare profession.
A spoken profession supplies the initial claim that cannot stand alone.
The assay of metal or person supplies the testing stage between claim and result.
Truth realized in act supplies the criterion exposed by the assay.

structural_cues: 29:2 contrasts saying with being tested; 29:3 names the truth exposed; 29:55 contrasts a final saying with prior doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim, assay, enacted truth, and final tasting; I infer the arrow claim -> tested action -> embodied result. A live alternative is that the opening test and final punishment are parallel accountability scenes without a single assay arc.

changed_reading.before: The command imposes a penalty for bad action.
changed_reading.after: The command is the terminal readout of the surah's assay: professed identity has become action, and action has become tasted evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speakers offer to carry another's errors but are denied that transfer and assigned weighted burdens; tasting internalizes the same rule, because an experience cannot be delegated to a proxy.

activation_trace.role: Personal experience supplies the non-transferable mode of consequence.
Intentional action identifies whose consequence is being experienced.
Bearing liability supplies the attempted but negated outsourcing mechanism.
Actual bearing of liability restores consequence to its responsible carriers.
Literal weight materializes moral liability as a load that remains attached.

structural_cues: 29:12 negates the promised carrying of others' errors; 29:13 immediately affirms the carrying of one's own and additional burdens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed transfer claim and restored burdens; I infer that tasting is the inward counterpart of carrying and therefore blocks proxy substitution. The alternative is that burden and taste are independent figures for generic accountability.

changed_reading.before: Each person receives an externally assigned penalty.
changed_reading.after: Consequence is inalienable: what was done returns as a personally borne and personally tasted experience that no sponsor can absorb instead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's upper and lower coordinates compress earlier punishment modalities: a calamity descends, a storm strikes from the exposed air, the earth sinks, and water engulfs. Separate histories become one closed spatial field.

activation_trace.role: General engulfing gathers the earlier modalities into one covering event.
Upper direction receives the descending and airborne modalities.
Lower direction receives the ground-collapse modality.
Downward arrival supplies an explicit above-to-below vector.
A stone-bearing wind supplies punishment through the exposed upper medium.
The earth's sinking supplies punishment through the lower support.
Drowning supplies an engulfing medium that erases a safe side.

structural_cues: 29:34 explicitly sends a calamity downward; 29:40 serializes airborne striking, earth-sinking, and drowning before 29:55 states the vertical totality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct disaster vectors; I infer that 29:55 maps them onto a compressed above/below coordinate system. A live alternative is that the pair simply means totality without recapitulating those histories.

changed_reading.before: Above and below are a generic formula for punishment on every side.
changed_reading.after: Above and below are a compressed disaster atlas in which the surah's earlier descending, sinking, and engulfing judgments converge around one body.

context_deltas.mechanism: Works previously received a beautified visual presentation even among people described through sight; the command to taste forces a change of sensory test, exposing as lived consequence what appearance had made attractive.

activation_trace.role: Experiential tasting supplies a sensory test that appearance cannot control.
Intentional work is the same object now tested by consequence.
Displayed attractiveness supplies the deceptive visual coating on the works.
The earlier occurrence identifies works as the object of beautification.
Inner sight supplies the irony that claimed perception did not pierce the coating.

structural_cues: 29:38 co-locates beautified works with being perceptive; 29:55 co-locates tasting with those same works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visually beautified works and later gustatory experience; I infer a corrective arrow from deceptive appearance to unavoidable taste. The alternative is that the sensory contrast is accidental and tasting only means undergoing punishment.

changed_reading.before: Tasting is simply a vivid synonym for suffering.
changed_reading.after: Tasting is a forced sensory cross-check: deeds once made to look good disclose their actual quality when they become lived consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demanded acceleration is opposed by a fixed limit and sudden arrival, while the next statement presents the fatal enclosure as already surrounding. The focus day is therefore the manifestation of a perimeter already in place, not the first instant of its construction.

activation_trace.role: A severe event-time supplies the appointed moment when latent enclosure becomes manifest.
General covering supplies the phenomenal realization of the prior perimeter.
Hastening supplies the subjects' attempted control over the schedule.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the schedule that resists their demand.
Suddenness supplies the break between hidden imminence and felt arrival.
Overwhelming enclosure supplies the already-fatal perimeter around the addressees.

structural_cues: 29:53 juxtaposes hastening, a fixed term, and surprise; 29:54 states enclosure before 29:55 narrates the day of covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed sudden arrival and a preceding statement of enclosure; I infer that covering reveals an existing trap. The alternative is a simple rhetorical sequence in which present wording anticipates a wholly future state.

changed_reading.before: At a future time punishment arrives and then surrounds them.
changed_reading.after: The appointed day makes an already-closing enclosure perceptible: their demand can alter neither its perimeter nor its timing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after terminal vertical closure, the address opens present horizontal space and commands worship. The warning thus distinguishes a still-available field of movement and response from the later state in which even footing is enclosed.

activation_trace.role: Total covering supplies the terminal state of spatial closure.
Walking on feet supplies the mobility that the lower punishment eventually blocks.
Expanse opposed to constriction supplies a present field of possible movement.
Submissive worship supplies the actionable response available within that open field.

structural_cues: 29:55 closes space around the body; the immediately following address in 29:56 declares the earth spacious and issues a command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate closure/expanse juxtaposition; I infer a temporal arrow from present room for movement and worship to later no-exit enclosure. The alternative is that 29:56 addresses migration independently of the spatial language in 29:55.

changed_reading.before: The ayah depicts an inescapable condition without temporal qualification.
changed_reading.after: It depicts terminal closure against a present window of spacious movement and worship, making no-exit the endpoint of refused opportunity rather than the current condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next recurrence makes death a taste shared by every self and couples it to return; this universal threshold distinguishes the focus's second, morally specified taste, whose object is one's own action.

activation_trace.role: Experiential tasting supplies the focus group's deed-specific encounter.
Intentional action specifies what differentiates this taste from the universal one.
The repeated experiential image supplies a universal comparison point.
Loss of life supplies the threshold every self experiences.
Return supplies the transition from universal mortality to differentiated consequence.

structural_cues: 29:55 assigns tasting an object made of prior action; 29:57 repeats tasting with every self as subject and death as object, then states return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two nearby tastes with different objects; I infer that death is the universal threshold while tasting deeds is morally differentiating. The alternative is that both are independent conventional metaphors with no staged relation.

changed_reading.before: Tasting punishment is simply another name for dying.
changed_reading.after: Death is the taste common to every self; the focus names a distinct post-return exposure in which a particular group's own work becomes the object tasted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus turns deeds into an engulfing vertical environment; the nearby reward scene also joins work to placement, but reverses the topology into upper rooms with rivers below. Action configures the world the actor inhabits.

activation_trace.role: General covering supplies the punitive habitat's outer envelope.
Upper direction supplies one axis of the punitive habitat.
Lower direction supplies the other axis of the punitive habitat.
Intentional action links the environment to what its occupants produced.
The repeated workers and work supply the positive side of the same action-to-environment relation.
Prepared emplacement supplies the act of assigning an inhabitable outcome.
An upper storey supplies elevated shelter rather than threat from above.
The repeated lower direction becomes a beneficial layer rather than an attacking one.
A watercourse cutting through earth supplies life flowing through the lower layer.

structural_cues: 29:55 joins work to punishment above and below; 29:58 joins work and workers to prepared upper rooms and rivers below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored work and vertical-space constructions; I infer that deeds become inhabitable topology. The alternative is a local reward/punishment contrast without a shared action-built spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Bad deeds earn pain while good deeds earn a separate reward.
changed_reading.after: Deeds become habitat: one group inhabits the enclosure generated by its work, while workers in the contrasting scene are placed in raised shelter with life flowing below.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the punishment root's palatable-sweet branch and the later patience root's bitter-plant branch around an explicit taste command. It remains anchored in the focus's punishment/taste pairing and the immediate reward context, but downstream prose should label it an exploratory root-field palate contrast, not translate punishment as sweetness or patience as bitterness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The punishment noun and imperative to taste create an explicit palate frame.

activation_trace.role: Palatable sweetness supplies the positive pole that punitive pain violently reverses.
Painful punishment supplies the dominant negative sense against which the reversal operates.
Literal tasting of food supplies the palate on which the polarity is staged.
A bitter plant and its extract supply a voluntarily endured counter-taste beside the imposed one.

changed_reading.before: The command only intensifies suffering through a conventional taste metaphor.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sequence stages two palates: punitive anti-sweetness forced on those tasting their work, and bitterness borne by the patient on the path to the contrasting habitat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a restraint branch of the punishment root into a ritual-preventive context rather than the dominant pain branch. It remains anchored through the focus's punishment and work construction plus 29:45's explicit restraint of conduct, but downstream prose should present it only as a temporal mechanism, not as a lexical redefinition of punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The punishment noun and the object made from prior work permit a question about when harmful work can still be stopped.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and weaning from a thing supply the branch image of forced cessation.
Intentional work supplies the conduct that has reached consequence.
Specified worship supplies the earlier practice through which conduct can be redirected.
Active checking and restraint supply the preventive alternative before work hardens into outcome.
Making or doing supplies the monitored conduct parallel to the focus's work.

changed_reading.before: Punishment only retaliates after wrongful work.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory branch level, the focus is terminal restraint: conduct once open to ritual self-checking has hardened into an outcome that now stops its maker by force.

strongest_changes: The opening assay changes the command into a terminal sequence from claim to tested action to embodied evidence.
Earlier descending, sinking, and engulfing disasters turn the focus's above/below pair into a compressed spatial atlas.
The preceding fixed term and already-surrounding enclosure make the focus day a manifestation of a trap whose timing cannot be controlled.
The nearby death and reward scenes distinguish universal tasting from deed-specific tasting and reverse punitive verticality into an inhabitable reward topology.
summary.what_was_special: The focus converts work into both sensorium and space: action is tasted as direct knowledge and becomes the environment around the actor, while nearby branch fields preserve a contained sweet-bitter palate activation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the earlier disaster vectors are intentionally recapitulated by the above/below pair or merely resonate with a generic totality formula.
Whether the visual-to-gustatory correction should shape downstream prose or remain a trace-level activation.
Whether the sweet-bitter and terminal-restraint branch patterns are rhetorically active or only useful exploratory diagnostics.
